subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.

The keeper had no intention to ________ (attend) the goal, but the ball was hit too hard to be stopped.
solution:
The correct answer is "**miss**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Attend**" typically means to go to or be present at an event, place, etc. (सहभागी होना) 

 
 
• **Example**- They always attend the morning meetings on time.
 
 
 
• "**Miss**" refers to fail to catch, reach, or attend. (छूक जाना)
 
 
• **Example**- He missed the train because of the traffic.
 
 
 
• Hence, the option that is opposite in meaning to the given word is "miss".

Therefore, the correct answer is **'option 4**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let's have a look at the meanings of the remaining options.
 
• "**Believe**" denotes accepting (something) as true; feeling sure of the truth of. (विश्वास करना)
 
• "**Bring**" signifies to take or go with (someone or something) to the place you are now or to the place you are going to. (ले जाना)
 
• "**Blow**" means to expel air forcibly through the mouth. (फूंक मारना)
